title: Soft but very thin
text: Soft but very thin. It doesn't even look like the same throw as the photo.  The "fur" is longer on the one I received than in the photo.  It soft but very thin.  I also purchased the Pinzon fleece throw, it is much softer and fuller than the Northpoint. I would recommend the Pinzon over this one.
